answer: A Sybil-resistant economy ties influence to slashable stake, not identity count: every agent posts a bond at a vertex of the trust graph and votes in proportion to locked capital. Splitting into a meadow of fake accounts cannot amplify power, because weight is summed per controller, so a gale of new names still demands the same total collateral. The attacker pays real locked funds that are slashed on detection, while honest agents earn yield from that same bond.
